Surgical placement of implant body: endosteal implant

code.text: Surgical extraction of tooth #30 with immediate endosteal implant placement

reasonReference.display: Site-specific radiation dose at tooth #30 (52 Gy, exceeds 45 Gy safe threshold)

note.text: Extraction and immediate implant placement, rather than delayed placement post-radiation, driven directly by the DDC dose finding (52 Gy > 45 Gy safe threshold) obtained in Interaction 2. Immediate placement avoids placing an implant into a field that will have already received high-dose radiation.
